extracted.intended_audience: film/TV production teams (producers, production managers, line producers, assistant directors) who prepare and approve Daily Production Reports
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating, completing, approving, and distributing a Daily Production Report (DPR) for a film or TV production using a mix of auto-filled information and manual entries. Covers timeliness, required content (releases, shot status, plate counts, timesheets), signing workflow, attachments, and format/export options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness (avoid being late)
rubrics_metrics.description: Being late with Daily Production Reports can cause your entire production to be shut down.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete and send DPRs promptly each day to avoid operational and legal/insurance risks; use tools that reduce time so you 'never be late again'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Efficiency — cut down reporting time
rubrics_metrics.description: Cut down daily production reporting from hours to minutes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Automate population of existing information and provide UI for quick manual finishing touches so DPRs are created and sent in record time (claimed 2–3 working hours saved per day).

rubrics_metrics.name: Automatic population of existing information
rubrics_metrics.description: DPRs automatically gathers all the relevant information you and your team have added for the specific day, from scenes shot, location and talent releases to plate count and working hours.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage data already entered elsewhere (call sheets, schedules, timesheets, release uploads) so fields are pre-filled; reduces duplicate typing and human error.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manual additions for non-automated items
rubrics_metrics.description: Leave some information open to be manually added such as payments and health & safety incidents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear editable fields for items that can't be auto-populated; mark required manual fields (payments, incidents) so nothing is omitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completeness — includes everything a DPR should
rubrics_metrics.description: The Daily Production Report includes everything a DPR should. You easily adapt it to your production and production size.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the DPR template covers standard DPR elements and is configurable for different production scales; allow delegation of input to other production members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Call sheet shot status update
rubrics_metrics.description: Add shot status directly in the call sheet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integrate call sheet shot status so what was shot and its status flows into the DPR automatically, reducing reconciliation work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location release reminders and release management
rubrics_metrics.description: Location release reminders, owner information and release upload.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track location release ownership, surface reminders when releases are missing, and attach uploaded release documents to the DPR for insurance/co-producer review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crew scheduling integration
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include crew schedule data (who worked, call times) so crew presence and changes are accurately reflected in the DPR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Daily cast scheduling capture
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capture day-by-day cast scheduling and use it to populate the DPR (who was present, who was used as atmosphere, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cast & crew time sheets inclusion
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include or link to time sheets to document working hours in the DPR; ensures labor reporting and payroll reconciliation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Food management & plate count reporting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track and report plate counts and catering details to the DPR; useful for budgets, health requirements, and continuity with meal penalties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Atmosphere cast contact info & releases
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain contact info and release status for background/atmosphere performers and attach releases to the DPR as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Smart signing workflow (approval & rejection management)
rubrics_metrics.description: Smart signing process where you can add exactly who should sign an individual DPR. Signers get a message in Dramatify (automatically forwarded to their email inbox) that they have a Daily Production Report to sign. They either sign it, or reject it with a comment, to be corrected and re-submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define signer list per report, send notifications, allow digital sign or reject-with-comment flows, and record approval history for audit and distribution to stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachments and accessible files in digital version
rubrics_metrics.description: In the digital version, files and attachments are accessible (clickable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach call sheets, releases, photos, or other documents to the DPR and ensure they are directly accessible from the report for insurers, investors, and co-producers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Export/printability for external distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: It can also be printed on paper or as a pdf and sent to co-producers, investors, insurance and bond companies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clean printable/PDF exports that include attachments or references so the DPR can be distributed outside the production software ecosystem.

rubrics_metrics.name: Configurable/adaptable template for production size
rubrics_metrics.description: You easily adapt it to your production and production size.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make the DPR template configurable (fields shown/hidden, level of detail) to suit small shoots through large-scale productions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation of DPR tasks
rubrics_metrics.description: Naturally, you can delegate these tasks to other members of your production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support role-based input where different crew members supply their parts of the DPR (e.g., 1st AD updates shot status, production coordinator uploads releases).

rubrics_metrics.name: Visibility for external stakeholders
rubrics_metrics.description: Send DPR to co-producers, investors, insurance and bond companies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the DPR contains the necessary documentation and formatting to satisfy external parties' requirements (releases, incident reports, plate counts, working hours).

rubrics_metrics.name: Template example availability / learn more
rubrics_metrics.description: Below you find an example of our DPR template. To learn about Dramatify’s Daily Production Reports in detail, please read the tutorial.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide example templates and tutorials so users understand required fields and the recommended workflow for producing compliant DPRs.
